Dear @poojaranjan, please include  [ERC-8100](https://github.com/ethereum/ERCs/pull/1396).

We recently added two ERCs ([8087](https://github.com/ethereum/ERCs/pull/1361) and [8100](https://github.com/ethereum/ERCs/pull/1396)), of course, it would be nice if both could be include, but w.r.t. limited resources, we favour 8100 to be included first, because we would like to reference it in the ERC-6123 documentation.

Hi @poojaranjan , could you please include [ERC-8085](https://github.com/ethereum/ERCs/pull/1359) and [ERC-8086](https://github.com/ethereum/ERCs/pull/1359) in the update?

These two proposals are designed to be introduced together, as ERC-8085 depends on ERC-8086 .
